description: Implement a function that returns the greatest common divisor of two positive integers using Euclid's algorithm. The function has iContract preconditions (both inputs are positive) and postconditions (result divides both inputs, and no larger value divides both).
test_cases:
assert gcd(12, 8) == 4
assert gcd(7, 13) == 1
assert gcd(100, 25) == 25
assert gcd(17, 17) == 17
print('All tests passed!')
